description: Use when an agent must read something a contract does not expose with a getter and has to decide from it: a raw storage slot, returned as hex and as an integer. It is how you find a proxy's implementation address, an owner or a paused flag. Do not use when the contract has a public getter (/v1/evm/call is the honest way) or for token data (/v1/evm/token-info). No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

slot.description: Slot number in decimal, or a 0x slot key such as an EIP-1967 hash.

name: evm_storage
title: Raw contract storage
